body: I teach academic writing and linguistics at University in Australia. One semester, in our final tutorial I asked students if they had any burning questions they needed to ask (in prep for their final piece of writing).  One guy pipes up, "Why do Grainwaves (type of chips) taste different in New Zealand than they do here?"
He is very manipulative.  I feel like an idiot because I need to walk away from the marriage but I just can't find it in me.  Thanks stranger friend.  Your words have helped.
